reason: I have never heard of PetMetro and I am not going to pay for food from an unknown brand when my cat is fine on the big bag of dry food I already buy. I might follow the page for the free pack, but that is not the same as spending money.
objection: It is a new brand with a booth that disappears after two weeks. I do not know where it is made or whether it will upset my cat's stomach, and after the event I would have to order by Facebook message instead of just picking it up at the pet shop.
would_change_my_mind: If my cat ate the free pack with no tummy trouble and the pouches were then sold at my usual pet shop at around RM 2 each, I would pick up a few as treats.
